responsibility: This implementation module implements the legacy REAL and LONGREAL text-conversion engine used by the Logitech compatibility libraries. It manages configurable exponent digit counts, computes decimal exponents and padding, builds fixed-point or scientific-notation strings with DynamicStrings and StringConvert helpers, handles width validation and NaN-style fallback behavior, and parses text back into LONGREAL or REAL values for the exported conversion procedures.
same_name_distinction: Implementation half of the RealConversions pair: it contains the formatting/parsing machinery, exponent handling, padding, and NaN fallback behavior behind the API declared in RealConversions.def.
